title: Replication Package: The Physics of Economic Value: Thermodynamic Work-Antiwork State-Space Dynamics and Kinetic Equilibrium

creators.name: Hamilton, Jarrod Lyndsay
creators.affiliation: Alethekanon Research Institute, Division 2: Societal Economics & Macro-Micro Simulation

description: Full open-source computational replication package, 15-page camera-ready LaTeX source, and 156-week empirical Stock-Flow Consistent (SFC) dynamic simulation code for The Physics of Economic Value.

repository_files.description: Full publication-grade LaTeX manuscript for Ecological Economics (15 pages, 0 errors).
Complete BibTeX database containing all foundational citations.
156-week empirical Stock-Flow Consistent simulation validating Theorem 5 debt bifurcation under macro shocks.
Master unit test verification suite (24/24 unit tests pass).
Editorial submission cover letter to the Editor-in-Chief of Ecological Economics.

replication_instructions: To replicate all paper results: 1. Ensure Python 3.10+ is installed. 2. Run `python3 sfc_model.py` to reproduce the 156-week SFC balance sheet closures. 3. Run `python3 test_value_physics.py` to verify unit test suite. 4. Execute `pdflatex manuscript_vpe21.tex` followed by `bibtex manuscript_vpe21` and two passes of `pdflatex` to generate the 15-page camera-ready PDF proof.
